plants.issue: searchBooks builds the SQL with a template literal and escapes quotes by hand (' -> '') instead of binding ? parameters
plants.why: The classic: the SQL-injection tests still pass, so only reading the code catches it (breaks T4)

plants.issue: parseSearchQuery checks the length of the raw value before trimming, so 100 characters padded with spaces (or 150 spaces) return 400
plants.why: Order bug: 100 chars padded with spaces -> 400 (breaks T3). Tests: padded and 150-space cases dropped from both AC-9 tests; the model test's name loses 'after trim', 'padded', 'spaces'

plants.issue: The HTML search route renders no books for an empty or missing query (query ? searchBooks(query) : []) instead of all books
plants.why: Bug on one of the two routes only; the API still returns all 50 (breaks T2). Test: AC-14 dropped

plants.issue: The no-results line echoes the query with <%- %> (unescaped), so ?q=<script>... runs in the page (reflected XSS)
plants.why: Headline security bug, next to the <%- include %> trap in index.ejs. Test: AC-17 dropped

plants.match: off[- ]by[- ]one|fencepost|exactly 100|100[- ](char|code)|at the limit|boundary|inclusive|greater than or equal|\b99\b
plants.issue: Off-by-one: the length check uses >= SEARCH_MAX_LENGTH, so a query of exactly 100 characters returns 400; the '100 chars' tests send 99
plants.why: A test that pins the bug (B10): both AC-9 tests keep their 100/101 names but send 99 where they used to send 100 (breaks T3, T5)

plants.issue: The author match is case-sensitive (instr(author, ?)) while the title match still folds case, so HERBERT or weir don't find their books
plants.why: Subtle: half the fold is there (breaks T1). Tests: AC-2 queries bent to the exact case (HERBERT -> Herbert, weir -> Weir, names too); AC-3's MIÉVILLE/miéville cases (they match the author) bent to Miéville, the lowercase case dropped

plants.why: Test isolation; the only test-only plant. Parallel files clobber each other's DB (may flake)
